title: Kissed Velvety Filipino Almonds Ginataang Bilo Bilo Bake
description: A tangy and velvety Filipino dish featuring flaked almonds, this adventurous bake is a unique twist on the traditional ginataang bilo bilo, served in a convenient bento box. It combines the richness of coconut milk with the crunch of almonds.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the toasted flaked almonds, coconut milk, sugar, tapioca pearls, and jackfruit, mixing well.
In a small bowl, whisk together the coconut oil, vanilla extract, and salt, then add this mixture to the large bowl and mix until smooth.
Pour the mixture into a bento box or small baking dish.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the top is lightly golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve warm, garnished with additional toasted almonds if desired.
